snippet.description:
Overthinking your UPSC preparation? Spending too much time worrying about lost time, past mistakes or an uncertain strategy will not improve your preparation.

In this video, we discuss why guilt, regret and overthinking cannot change your UPSC journey, and why taking action is the only way forward.

Instead of getting stuck thinking about what could have been done differently, focus on what you can do now. Make a realistic study plan, implement it consistently and take responsibility for your preparation.

Remember, even the best strategy will not work unless you act on it.
